<!-- pr-reviewer: 1329d42c71cb90c7486a503e5d93b5c496ba5cc8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new gate checks the operations that use the default machine. It uses the same spindle speed rule and feed ceiling as the mounted-machine checks. The tests confirm that a mounted machine keeps its own limits. A refusal writes no output file.

I reviewed this safety change against the current upstream `AGENTS.md`. The PR changes no UI, dependencies, build scripts, or golden files.

All commands ran locally in the foreground. The trial merge with upstream main `feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5` had no conflicts.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -j 6 --no-run` | PASS |
| `default_machine_limits` | 6 passed |
| `default_machine_missing` | 9 passed |
| `machine` | 33 passed |
| `machine_switch` | 6 passed |
| `per_op_files` | 9 passed |
| `per_op_script_options` | 2 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `setup_mount` | 6 passed |
| `setup_mounts_post` | 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -j 6 --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

I ran two independent mutation checks:

1. I removed the spindle ceiling check temporarily. `no_mounted_machine_is_refused_above_the_default_spindle_maximum` failed. The refusal contained only `spindle rpm over machine maximum`.
2. I removed the feed ceiling check temporarily. `no_mounted_machine_is_refused_above_the_default_feed_rate` failed. The program posted with `F7000`.

I restored the source byte for byte after each check. All six limit tests passed again after restoration.

Requested changes: none.

The GUI and release-only test suites were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
